CITY OF ALHAMBRA DESIGN REVIEW BOARD
  ACTION MINUTES

  Regular Meeting
  March 10, 2026

A.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER:  7:00 P.M. in Conference Room A of Alhambra City Hall.

B.  ROLL CALL:

  Present:  Ankit Udani, Vice Chairman; Stanley Tsai; Jennifer Ng

  Absent:  Nora Hernandez, Chairman; Michael Daninger

  Staff Present: Steve Kuchenski, Secretary/City Architect; Eric Martinez, City Architect
  Representative

C.  CONSENT AGENDA:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 1:  MINUTES – February 24, 2026
  • Request: This is a request for the Design Review Board to approve
  the Minutes of the February 24, 2026, Regular Meeting of the Design
  Review Board.
  • Recommended Action: Design Review Board review and approve
  as submitted the Minutes of the February 24, 2026, Regular Meeting
  of the Design Review Board.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Consent Agenda Item 1.
  •  Moved by Board Member Tsai, Seconded by Vice Chairman Udani.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 3-0-0-2
  Ayes:  Udani, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Hernandez, Daninger

D.  DISCUSSION ITEMS:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 2:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-016
  • 421 East San Marino Avenue
  • Applicant: Michelle Huang
  • Request: This is an application for modifications to an existing CMU
  block wall located on the property of an existing single-family
  residence.

  1
  03/10/2026
   •  Recommended Action: APPROVE. The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application without conditions.
  •  Moved by Board Member Ng, Seconded by Board Member Tsai.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 3-0-0-2
  Ayes:  Udani, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Hernandez, Daninger

AGENDA
ITEM 3:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-132
  • 2629 Orange Grove Avenue
  • Applicant: Phoenix Hong & Thanh Dang
  • Request: This is an application for the installation of a new vehicular
  swing gate within the driveway of an existing single-family residential
  property.

  •  Recommended Action: APPROVE. The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application without conditions.
  •  Moved by Board Member Ng, Seconded by Board Member Tsai.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 3-0-0-2
  Ayes:  Udani, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Hernandez, Daninger

AGENDA
ITEM 4:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-140
  • 27 South Meridian Avenue
  • Applicant: Keith Wismer
  • Request: This is an application for the replacement of garage doors
  on an existing detached garage located at the rear of a single-family
  residential property and accessed from Waverly Drive.

  •  Recommended Action: APPROVE. The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.

  2
  03/10/2026
   MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application without conditions.
  •  Moved by Board Member Ng, Seconded by Board Member Tsai.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 3-0-0-2
  Ayes:  Udani, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Hernandez, Daninger

  AGENDA
  ITEM 5:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-103
  • 1156 West Valley Boulevard
  • Applicant: Julie Li & John Hong
  • Request: This is an application for exterior alterations to an existing
  commercial building in conjunction with tenant improvements for a
  new restaurant business known as “Joy’s Express.”

  •  Recommended Action: APPROVE. The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application without conditions.
  •  Moved by Board Member Ng, Seconded by Board Member Tsai.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 3-0-0-2
  Ayes:  Udani, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Hernandez, Daninger

E.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

  •  There were no Oral Communications.

  3
  03/10/2026
   AGENDA ITEM NO. 1

F.  ADJOURNMENT:

  •  There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned at 7:31 P.M. to
